evidence_families.note: Every family remains in the canonical evidence_family table.

limitations: No candidate assertion has completed clinical or mapping review.
MedlinePlus extraction uses exact deterministic terminology matches only.
Monarch is aggregated knowledge; primary sources are retained and are not independent by default.
The compatibility score is deterministic engineering output, never a probability.
No safety, triage, laboratory, medication, pediatric, pregnancy or treatment coverage.
